doi.description: The target DOI of the enrichment record.

action.description: The action that the enrichment performs. The available actions are: update (change the entire top-level "field" from the "originalValue" to the "enrichedValue") updateChild (change a child object within the top-level "field" from the "originalValue" to the "enrichedValue") insert (insert the object in "enrichedValue" into the top-level "field") deleteChild (remove the object in "originalValue" within the top-level field specified in "field")

originalValue.description: When the action is update, updateChild, or deleteChild, the original value of the field or child value. Otherwise, this field is empty.

enrichedValue.description: When the action is update, updateChild, or insert, the enriched value of the field or child value. Otherwise, this field is empty.

sourceId.description: The source id (DOI) of the enrichment record.
